Thank you for your interest in Moving Together: Deliberative Workshops on Robots and Transport.

The workshops will look at the following question: 

Robots could make our buses and trains cheaper, cleaner and more reliable. 

What risks are worth accepting, and which should we refuse?

The workshops will take place in Birmingham on the following dates: 

  • Saturday 7th November -  9.30am - 17.00pm

  • Sunday 8th November -  9.30am  - 17.00pm

Everyone who takes part will receive £375 as a thank you for your time. If there is anything we can do to help you to take part, we are happy to discuss this with you. Please register for the event whatever your situation, and someone will be in touch if you are selected to take part.

If you need help registering or have other questions please call our Freephone number 0808 157 0123. Lines are open 8am–8pm every day. You can also email questions to hello@civic-lottery.example.org . 

IMPORTANT NOTES:

  • Everyone who registers online must have their own email address. If you do not have an email address, please ring the Freephone number above to register.

  • All fields marked with an asterisk (*) must be completed.

  • We will share all your details with Harbour Research, the organisation running this event. They will make a separate data agreement with you if you are selected to take part. Your data will be kept strictly confidential. We will delete your details one year after the event ends, unless you tell us otherwise below. Please read our Privacy Policy for more details.

  • You can withdraw your consent at any time and ask us to delete your data, or request a copy of it, by emailing privacy@civic-lottery.example.org. If you ask us to delete your data, we will tell the other organisation(s) listed above to do the same.
